en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Student receives these knowledge and skills about soil milieu in plant growing, about importance of nutrients for horticultural and oranmental plants plant and the influence of soil properties on yield and quality of plant production, about principles of application of mineral and organic fertilizers and about principles of precise fertilization of plants.
